fields.description: The Agent this Procedure is bound to. Binding, not an Agent Tool Function row per pair (GOAL.md 3.1) -- exposure to the model is computed at runtime from enabled bindings, in huf.ai.sdk_tools.
fields.label: Agent

fields.description: The exact Agent Procedure VERSION row this binding pins (docname procedure_id-vN). Promotion/rollback is changing this link on the binding -- an atomic binding move (I6) -- never editing the Procedure row it points at.
fields.label: Procedure (pinned version)

fields.description: Denormalized from procedure.procedure_id at validate time. Read-only.
fields.label: Procedure ID

fields.description: Denormalized from procedure.version at validate time. Read-only.
fields.label: Version

fields.description: Only an enabled binding is exposed to the model at runtime. Only one enabled binding may exist per (agent, procedure_id) at a time -- disable the old binding (or let promotion move this one's `procedure` link) rather than adding a second enabled row for the same logical procedure.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: Higher priority bindings are exposed first when an agent's enabled binding count exceeds the per-agent cap (huf.ai.graph.procedure_binding.get_binding_cap). Ties broken by modified time.
fields.label: Priority

fields.description: Whether T-32's fallback protocol may fall back to the agentic path when this bound procedure's run fails. Does not itself invoke anything -- read by T-32.
fields.label: Fallback Enabled

fields.description: Rolling health signal for this binding, maintained by T-33's monitoring (out of scope here). Never gates exposure by itself in this wave.
fields.label: Health
